name: IUCN Save Our Species grants
summary: IUCN's species grant-making programme, which opens calls for proposals under donor-funded initiatives for projects that protect threatened species and their habitats.

eligibility.rule: Operates in the EU and not an EU overseas territory, except the Canary Islands, Azores or Madeira
Project lasts no more than 12 months

applicant_types.quote: IUCN Save Our Species provides funding to civil society, Indigenous Peoples, researchers, youth and many other organisations working to protect and conserve threatened species.

access.quote: We regularly open calls for proposals for conservation projects.

window.quote: We regularly open calls for proposals for conservation projects.

effort.quote: Deadline: Wednesday, 10 February 2027 at 14:00 CEST Apply now via the IUCN Grants Portal

eligibility.quote: The call is open to organisations operating in the European Union, EU overseas countries and territories are not eligible, except for the Canary Islands, the Azores and Madeira.
Grants ranging from €10,000 to €50,000 are available for projects of up to 12 months.
